_why: The single place the pinned golangci-lint version is written down.
It used to be a literal in five workflow steps across two workflows, which
is the failure mode compat/drift.py exists to catch, one level down: a job
left behind on an older binary compares against something nobody thinks is
the baseline, and the gate goes on printing OK.
Bumping golangci_lint here is a deliberate act. Do it only after
compat/drift.py has been run against the new version and its report
_shelled_out_why: Two tools golangci-lint *links* and guff *shells out to*. A different
version on either side turns a formatting difference into a false compat
diff, so the isolate tier installs exactly what golangci-lint embeds at the
pin. Read golines off golangci-lint's go.mod; swaggo is indirect —
golangci-lint depends on github.com/golangci/swaggoswag, a hard fork whose
readme names the upstream swaggo/swag commit it is synced with, and that
commit is what `go install` can actually fetch.
